## General Eligibility Amendment - Revision 8.4

Effective 2026-10-01, the standard voluntary return window in General Eligibility is 45 calendar days from delivery for unopened products with proof of purchase. This supersedes only the prior 30-calendar-day general window. REGION-EEA-STATUTORY, REGION-BR-ONLINE, REGION-CA-RECALL, and the integration metadata remain in force without change.
